notes.title: Notes for the 1.2 update
notes.content:
You’re probably wondering what’s changed, so here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*] We’ve integrated pretest and posttest features, and now the software is completely free and unlimited.
[*] We improved performance on VR headsets by refactoring the code, resulting in a smoother user experience with higher frame rates. 
[*] It should be compatible with all VR headsets thanks to OpenXR integration.
[*] We redesigned the delay stage interface to make it more intuitive and easier to use.
[/list]

Additionally, we’ve made significant progress on the version for Meta standalone devices, so stay tuned!

We hope you enjoy these updates! Don’t forget to leave us your feedback, which always helps us improve.

notes.title: bug fixes
notes.content:
- Improved grabbing of small objects
- Texts have been corrected
- Fixed the final score marker so that it correctly displays hits and misses.
